page.title: Marbella Yacht Charter for Pride 2029: Parties & Parades

data.meta_description: Book a Marbella yacht charter for Pride 2029. Party at sea, watch parades from the water, and celebrate with up to 12 guests. Depart Puerto Banús.
data.summary: Celebrate Pride 2029 in style with a yacht charter from Marbella. Watch parades from the water, party with friends, and enjoy free-flowing drinks and snacks.
key_facts: Pride 2029 events in Marbella and Puerto Banús include parades and beach parties.
Charters depart from Puerto Banús, a 5-minute walk from the main parade route.
Capacities range from 5 to 12 guests per boat.
All charters include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance.
Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) from €749 for 2 hours.
Tier B boats (Mangusta 80) from €4,719 for 4 hours, with free jet ski.
Book via WhatsApp for prices on other boats like Ferretti 94 or Pershing 46.

faq.q: What is included in a Marbella yacht charter for Pride 2029?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs.

faq.q: Which boats are best for a Pride party?
faq.a: For up to 12 guests, the Mangusta 80 (24m) or Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m) offer spacious decks and flybridges. For a smaller group, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) is a great value option.

faq.q: Can we watch the Pride parade from the boat?
faq.a: Yes—the parade route runs along the Puerto Banús promenade. You can anchor nearby or moor in the marina to watch from deck. The view from the water is often less crowded than the streets.

faq.q: How do we book a yacht for Pride 2029?
faq.a: Contact us via WhatsApp on the boat listing pages. Let us know your preferred date, group size, and budget. We'll confirm availability and send a booking link within hours.

faq.q: What is the cancellation policy for Pride charters?
faq.a: Standard policy: full refund if cancelled 14 days before departure. Within 14 days, a 50% refund or reschedule subject to availability. Pride dates are popular—book early.

faq.q: Can we bring our own decorations or music?
faq.a: Yes, you're welcome to bring Pride flags, banners, and a Bluetooth speaker or USB playlist. The boat's sound system can also connect to your phone. Just avoid anything that could damage the upholstery.

faq.q: Is there a minimum age for guests?
faq.a: Children are welcome on all boats. For safety, infants must wear life jackets (provided). No minimum age for adults, but all guests must be able to follow the skipper's instructions.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad on Pride day?
faq.a: The skipper will assess conditions. If it's unsafe to sail, we'll reschedule or offer a full refund. Marbella averages 300 sunny days a year, so risk is low in June.

data.body_html:
Pride 2029 in Marbella promises to be the biggest celebration yet—and there’s no better way to experience it than from the deck of a private yacht. Whether you want to watch the parade from the water, anchor near a beach party, or simply enjoy a day out with friends, a Marbella yacht charter gives you space, freedom, and a front-row seat. All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, just steps from the main action.

Why charter a yacht for Pride 2029?

Pride parades in Marbella draw thousands to the Golden Mile and Puerto Banús. Streets get crowded, bars fill up, and finding a quiet spot can be a challenge. A yacht solves that. You get your own private venue with a licensed skipper, unlimited drinks, and snacks—no queues, no noise restrictions, and a panoramic view of the coastline.

Plus, you control the music, the guest list, and the itinerary. Fancy a swim between parade floats? Drop anchor off Cala del Faro. Want to catch the sunset after the march? Cruise towards La Concha. It’s your day.

Which boats are available for Pride charters?

We have boats for groups of 5 to 12 guests. Here’s a quick overview of the most popular options for parties:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours. Great value for a small group.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – same pricing tier. Spacious cockpit and sunpad.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – from €4,719 for 4 hours, includes a free jet ski. Ideal for a premium party.
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) – price on request via WhatsApp. Flybridge offers extra social space.
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – the ultimate luxury option. Enquire for pricing.

All charters include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and tax. No hidden extras.

What’s the Pride 2029 schedule in Marbella?

Exact dates for 2029 are usually announced in early 2029 by Marbella Pride organisers. Historically, the main parade takes place on a Saturday in late June, with pre-parties on Friday and a beach closing party on Sunday. The parade route typically starts at the Alameda Park and ends at Puerto Banús.

We recommend booking your yacht for the full day (8 hours) to enjoy both the parade and an afternoon cruise. You can anchor near the marina to watch the floats, then head out to sea for a swim and sunset.

How to combine Pride with a coastal cruise

Marbella’s coastline offers several spots that are perfect for a Pride day. After watching the parade, ask your skipper to take you to:

  • Cala del Faro – a quiet cove west of Marbella, ideal for swimming and photos.
  • Cala Cortés – another small bay with clear water, popular for anchoring.
  • Estepona – a 30-minute cruise west, with a colourful old town and beach clubs.
  • Cabopino – a sandy beach with a dune system, quieter than the main beaches.

If you want to stay close to the party, Puerto Banús itself has plenty of bars and restaurants within walking distance from the marina.

Tips for a perfect Pride yacht day

Here’s what we recommend to make the most of your charter:

  • Book early – Pride is one of the busiest weekends in Marbella. Yachts get reserved weeks in advance.
  • Arrive at the marina 15 minutes early – your skipper will meet you at the Puerto Banús dock.
  • Bring sunscreen and a hat – June sun in Marbella is strong, and the sea breeze can fool you.
  • Wear comfortable shoes – boat decks can get slippery, and you’ll be moving around.
  • Plan your playlist – most boats have Bluetooth or AUX input. Create a Pride-themed mix.
